title: ～てもらう — “have / get someone to ～”
summary: Shows that you get someone to do something for you. Add もらう to the te-form. The doer is marked with に, and you are the subject.

patterns.gloss: Verb te-form + もらう (直してもらう)

body.p: You describe it from the receiver’s side: 先生に作文を直してもらった. It states the same fact as ～てくれる but from the person who benefits.
For superiors use ～ていただく. For requests: ～てもらえませんか, ～ていただけませんか.

examples.ja: 友達（ともだち）に引っ越（ひっこ）しを手伝（てつだ）ってもらいました。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi ni hikkoshi o tetsudatte moraimashita.
examples.tr: I got my friend to help me move.

examples.ja: 先生（せんせい）に作文（さくぶん）を直（なお）してもらいました。
examples.romaji: Sensei ni sakubun o naoshite moraimashita.
examples.tr: I had my teacher correct my composition.

examples.ja: 母（はは）に駅（えき）まで車（くるま）で送（おく）ってもらった。
examples.romaji: Haha ni eki made kuruma de okutte moratta.
examples.tr: I got my mother to drive me to the station.

pitfalls: Mark the doer with に, not が.
The subject is you, the receiver.
